comment: The disposition ledger (pt.3, operator-confirmed): every non-SERVED, non-refusal finding gets a column -- built / refused / parked-with-reason / undecided. 'undecided' is legal forever; ABSENT is the only red (CI-enforced in passenger-sweep.mjs). Refusals live in refusals.json and are the 'refused' column of this same ledger, not duplicated here.

constraints/needs-food-en-route.reason: POI claim deferred on Overpass cost (reviewer triage 2026-07-28 13:12); gap mechanic already serves the slack half

conditions/delay-50min.reason: replan-from-here SHIPPED, so the row went LEFT_BEHIND -> PARTIAL (2026-07-29, forced by the absence-rot check). What is parked is only the residual: whether the app should offer the replan unprompted instead of waiting to be asked

comment-2026-08-05: The six rows above were adjudicated together on 2026-08-05 (the last 22 axis values) and are genuinely undecided -- measured or repo-grounded the same day, no decision yet taken on any. Two share one candidate fix: midnight-crossing and international-connection both come down to cards rendering hhmm() with no day marker, so one day-boundary tag on the card would move both. bike-carriage is the sharpest: the passenger cannot even learn that the app cannot answer -- a one-line honest caveat OR a refusals.json entry (policy call, operator's) would each be better than the current silence.
comment-phrasing-2026-07-31: The seven phrasing rows were adjudicated together on 2026-07-31 and are all genuinely undecided: they were measured the same hour and nobody has ruled on what to do about them. Recording them as parked-with-reason would be inventing a decision nobody took. Six of the seven share ONE root cause -- locations() renders API rows with id:null (businesses, addresses, city quarters) as tappable station suggestions, while nearbyStops() in the same file already filters exactly those out -- so one fix moves most of this block at once. See the phrasing header in axes.mjs and tests/passengers/phrasing-evidence.json.
